subject.title: feat(tui): opt-in persistence and agent visibility for `!`/`!!` local shell commands

question: Should OpenClaw adopt durable, optionally model-visible TUI local-shell output and the `!`/`!!` prefix contract as supported behavior?
rationale: This adds a durable transcript type, hidden Gateway write API, user-facing privacy semantics, and long-term prefix convention; implementation review cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Sponsor and harden
options.body: Adopt the opt-in model after idempotency, fresh-session, artifact-cleanup, and exact-head proof blockers are resolved.

options.title: Persist locally only
options.body: Keep resume history but exclude shell rows from agent context, avoiding a model-sharing prefix contract.

options.title: Decline persistence
options.body: Keep TUI local shell execution ephemeral and preserve only independently useful fixes in narrower work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and harden
recommendation.body: Adopt the opt-in model after idempotency, fresh-session, artifact-cleanup, and exact-head proof blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR timeline shows direct engagement, and the decision spans product, Gateway, TUI, session, and privacy semantics.
